summary: Demonstrate the offline planner folio and approval-gated GitHub reconciliation.

architecture.changeSummary: Replace an implicit planning handoff with one sidecar that visibly carries investigation through human approval to deterministic GitHub reconciliation.

components.name: Plan sidecar
components.purpose: Carries stable architecture and issue data.

components.name: GitHub reconciler
components.purpose: Applies only an explicitly approved plan.

diagramsMermaid.currentArchitecture:
flowchart LR
  Research[Read-only investigation] --> Notes[Ad hoc planning notes]
  Notes --> Manual[Manual GitHub setup]
diagramsMermaid.targetArchitecture:
flowchart LR
  Research[Read-only investigation] --> Sidecar[Plan sidecar]
  Sidecar --> Folio[Offline HTML folio]
  Sidecar --> Gate{Human approval}
  Gate --> GitHub[Milestone and issues]

issues.title: Render the offline plan folio
issues.body: Render the fixed publication sections and four Mermaid views without external resources.

acceptanceTests.name: four_diagram_svgs
acceptanceTests.oracle: rendered HTML contains four inline SVG diagram blocks

issues.title: Reconcile the approved GitHub milestone
issues.body: Preview changes, stop for human approval, then create, update, close, and deduplicate marked issues.

acceptanceTests.name: idempotent_rerun
acceptanceTests.oracle: second reconcile against applied state yields zero actions

risks.title: Renderer and reconciler drift apart
risks.mitigation: Both read the same validated sidecar; the renderer rejects unknown fields so a schema change cannot land silently.

risks.title: Approval is inferred from silence
risks.mitigation: --apply requires an explicit --approved-by identity; a changed sidecar invalidates prior approval.

risks.title: Mermaid fails to render offline
risks.mitigation: Every diagram ships its source in a details fallback that becomes visible when rendering throws.
